info.title: stanzasharp
info.description: The stanzasharp command: downloads Stanza's English models for StanzaSharp, checked against their MD5s, e.g. in a Dockerfile or CI. "stanzasharp download DIR [--package default_fast] [--processors tokenize,mwt,pos]". "stanzasharp compare FILE" runs Python Stanza and StanzaSharp on your own text and shows whether their output is identical; "stanzasharp benchmark" measures both on your machine. Needs no native libtorch.

options.name: --package
options.description: Stanza's English package: default, or default_fast (faster, no constituency)

options.name: --processors
options.description:
comma-separated, from tokenize,mwt,pos,lemma,constituency,depparse,sentiment,ner
(default: all of the package's)

options.name: --models
options.description: compare, benchmark: the models (default: models/stanza/en)

options.name: --python
options.description: compare, benchmark: the Python with Stanza installed (default: python)

options.name: --threads
options.description:
benchmark: threads on both sides (default: each side's own default, StanzaSharp the
physical cores from 4 up, else all logical processors; torch the physical cores)

options.name: --words
options.description:
benchmark: the text's length in words, counted by whitespace (default: 1500); the block
counts words after tokenizing (2,009 for the default)

options.name: --quick
options.description: benchmark: 300 words (by whitespace), one run, 10 calls

options.name: --json
options.description: benchmark: also write the results as JSON
